title: Into color
description: Whole paintings keep their proportions as an expanding collection repacks into aligned rows.
useCase: Build image collections where original aspect ratios and visual continuity matter more than uniform crops.
interaction: Add a study, then remove it. Existing artworks change rows while keeping their identities and proportions.
reducedMotion: Packing updates immediately. Keyboard actions and host pause finish at the target layout without travel.
limitations: Eight local public-domain paintings, bounded exhaustive row partitioning and authored 532 px gallery width inside a responsive 600×375 stage. This is not virtualized for large collections.
look: A warm-white curatorial wall of saturated paintings in two flush rows, with a single round plus control centered beneath the artwork.
motion: A bounded row-partition search finds aspect-correct boxes. Existing images animate from their currently rendered transform to the new row, and the added study fades into place. Interrupted reflows retain the current visual pose.
adapt: Replace the image dimensions, titles and IDs in `WORKS`; `pack` scores candidate row partitions against `targetHeight` and a fixed stage bound. `gutter` and `lastRow` change the packing, while `layoutMs` controls the next transform transition.
